kills.claim: Witt-carry equations on lifted relations are ideal-redundant
kills.argument: T is a group homomorphism on odd-order points (Voloch-Walker). If P1+..+Pm=R in E(F_q) then T(P1)+..+T(Pm)=T(R) holds automatically; second-coordinate equations x_1(T(Pi))=F(x_0,y_0) are fixed rational functions of the mod-2 unknowns, so the lifted system is the mod-2 system composed with F: zero new constraints, zero rank gain. Matches prediction_if_false 'zero rank gain from carry layer'.

kills.claim: Frobenius-stable l-dim F_2-subspaces V with l=3..5 do not exist for the toy n
kills.argument: Squaring-stable F_2-subspaces of F_{2^n} (normal-basis module F_2[X]/(X^n-1)) have dims that are sums of {1} and multiples of ord_n(2); for n prime and l in 3..5 only l in{0,1,n-1,n,...} or ord-multiples exist. So 'Frobenius-stable base' requires V=F_2 or dim>=ord_n(2); the B~2^{n/m'} claim has no instantiation. This is the no-subfield wall re-encountered on the x_1 coordinate.

kills.claim: B_w is a rational-map-preimage factor base; known class (HPST / Galbraith-Gebregiyorgis)
kills.argument: x_1=F(x_0,y_0) with F over F_2 of bounded degree d (Finotti). Membership F(x0,y0) in V is an F_2-linear condition on a fixed degree-d map of x_0, i.e. a non-subspace factor base given by a low-degree algebraic set. Its Weil-descent system is S_{m+1} plus n-l linear forms in F(x_i): equivalent to the subspace system after substitution with degree multiplied by d. Same variable count, higher degree -> d_F >= subspace d_F. No new structure beyond representation of x_0; relation yield for |B| fixed equals random-set heuristic m!-count.

Membership test is evaluation of a fixed public rational function of the point; CGK preprocessing bound B*D^2 >= N applies to any such scheme absent a representation-dependent decomposition speedup, which K3 shows reduces to the existing subspace case with worse degree.

surviving_weak_form: none beyond engineering: x_1-based base is a valid alternative non-subspace base with same asymptotics as subspace base, degree inflated by deg F.
not_computed: GR(4,n) ANF degree and msolve d_F comparison (skipped: K1/K3 are structural)
scope_of_kill: Kills carry-layer and Frobenius-stable claims for prime n with ord_n(2)>5; does not address n where ord_n(2) is small (e.g. Mersenne-like n with ord small), nor higher Witt levels used with non-homomorphic lifts.
